'''Sairisi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was the security chief of a secret facility installed by the [[Order of Revan]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. In [[3637 BBY]], the facility was [[Operation on Manaan|invaded]] by forces opposing the Order, and Sairisi attempted to defend the installation, but was killed in action.
